title: Round Hill
synopsis: The lamps on Round Hill go out, and the Hush looks over the top. It is faster than the train. But a hill is a hill: you can always go round it.
note: The last train runs again tomorrow.
lines: Next stop: Lamp Town. Hold the bar!
The hill lamps went out. It's here.
It's coming round the hill. Full steam!
Lights off! Keep the hill between us.
It goes round. We go round.
It can't see us. Nice and slow.
The switch! Lights on! Full steam!
Lamp Town! Thank you, little star.
It will be back. Hold the bar.
